english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a quality standard, benchmark, or agreed requirement.
This is the all-purpose choice when “measure” means a standard or criterion for judging something.
Use this for a target or level of achievement, as in “raise the bar.”

examples.english: The service standard at this restaurant is very high.
examples.traditional: 呢間餐廳嘅服務標準好高。
